notes: Age comparisons are shown within each vaccine and dose with no computed contrast, which was read as comparison rather than stratified. The similarity to preauthorization trial findings rests on cited trial results. Serious VAERS reports were reviewed by physicians for a clinical impression; this is case classification, not a procedure.
view_issues: The methods state p<0.05 as significant, but no test or p-value is reported. The text gives eight seizures (six afebrile); Table 3 lists 7 seizures plus 1 febrile seizure, and its note says six of seven were afebrile. The Discussion says 92% of error reports had no adverse event; Table 3 gives 90.1%. Fever is 19.8% in the text and 19.7% in the table.
